name: view: each comparison operator, over a numeric column
view: `not` binds tighter than `and`, which binds tighter than `or`
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
Id, N, S
a, 1, open
b, 5, open
c, 9, shut
===

=== view {#v src=#t where="not S = 'shut' and N > 1 or N = 1"}
===

name: view: a quoted column name compares against a quoted literal
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
Unit Price, Id
10, a
4, b
===

=== view {#v src=#t where="'Unit Price' > 5"}
===

name: view: a cell that is not a number does not match a numeric comparison, and is not a diagnostic
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
Id, N
a, 8
b, x
===

=== view {#v src=#t where="N > 1"}
===

name: view: `asc` is the default direction, and a tie keeps source order
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
Id, N
d, 2
a, 1
c, 2
b, 1
===

=== view {#v src=#t order="N"}
===

name: view: `limit=` without `order=` takes the first rows in source order
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
Id, N
c, 3
a, 1
b, 2
===

=== view {#v src=#t limit=2}
===

name: view: `where=` may name a column `compute=` derives per row
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
Id, Q1, Q2
a, 8, 10
b, 1, 2
===

=== view {#v src=#t compute="FY = Q1 + Q2" where="FY > 5"}
===

name: view: `sum()` means the same in `compute=` and in `summary=` — both over the rows shown
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
Id, N
a, 1
b, 4
c, 5
===

=== view {#v src=#t where="N > 1" compute="Share [%.2f] = N / sum(N)" summary="N = sum(N)"}
===

name: view: `select=` narrows and reorders, and runs after `order=` and `limit=`
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
Id, N, S
a, 1, x
b, 9, y
c, 5, z
===

=== view {#v src=#t order="N desc" limit=2 select="S, Id"}
===

name: view: a source's summary row does not cross into the view that consumes it
view: `by=` with `aggregate=` publishes the keys then the aggregate names
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
Area, N
infra, 8
ops, 2
infra, 1
===

=== view {#g src=#t by="Area" aggregate="Rows = count(N); Total = sum(N)"}
===

name: view: `by=` with no `aggregate=` is the distinct set of those keys, in first-seen order
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
Area
ops
infra
ops
===

=== view {#d src=#t by="Area"}
===

name: view: `where=` on a grouping view filters the INPUT rows; filtering the groups is the next view
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
Area, N
infra, 8
ops, 2
infra, 1
ops, 9
===

=== view {#g src=#t where="N > 1" by="Area" aggregate="Rows = count(N)"}
===

=== view {#busy src=#g where="Rows > 1"}
===

name: view: text ordering compares code units, so a row order does not depend on the processor's locale
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
Name
banana
Apple
cherry
===

=== view {#v src=#t order="Name asc"}
===

name: display: with no format a number shows 12 significant digits, then its shortest form
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
N
1
2
===

=== view {#v src=#t compute="X = N / 3; Y = N * 1000000000000000000000"}
===

name: display: %.Nf rounds the exact value, ties away from zero — 0.125 is a tie, 2.675 is stored below one
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
N
0.125
-0.125
2.675
0.375
===

=== view {#v src=#t compute="X [%.2f] = N"}
===

name: display: %d rounds ties away from zero, the same as %.0f
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
N
0.5
2.5
-2.5
-1.5
===

=== view {#v src=#t compute="D [%d] = N; F [%.0f] = N"}
===

name: display: %.Ne writes at least two exponent digits
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
N
1
25
===

=== view {#v src=#t compute="X [%.3e] = N / 3; Y [%.0e] = N"}
===

name: display: %.Ng keeps N significant digits, in exponent form below 1e-4 or from 10^N
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
N
1
1234
0.00001234
100
===

=== view {#v src=#t compute="X [%.3g] = N / 3; Y [%.3g] = N; Z [%.2g] = N"}
===

name: display: width and flags are not part of a format and are ignored
view: a view with no `src=` is empty — no columns and no rows, and nothing else applied (§6.1)
geml:
=== view {#a select=x}
===

name: view: a view whose `src=` names no block is empty (§6.1)
geml:
=== view {#a src=#nope select=x where="N > 1"}
===

name: view: a view whose `src=` names a block that publishes no relation is empty (§6.1)
view: each view whose chain of sources meets a cycle is reported — the cycle's own and one running into it — and is empty (§6.1, §9.3)

name: view: a chain of 16 views publishes at its end (§6.1, §9.3)
view: the 17th view of a chain is view-source-too-deep and publishes no rows (§6.1, §9.3)
view: a `select=` entry naming no column contributes nothing, and the others still select (§6.1)
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
Id, N
b, 2
a, 1
===

=== view {#v src=#t select="N, Nope"}
===

name: view: a `select=` with no valid entry leaves the view no columns, its rows kept (§6.1)
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
Id, N
b, 2
a, 1
===

=== view {#v src=#t select="Nope"}
===

name: view: a `select=` entry holding `=` contributes nothing, and the others still select (§6.1)
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
Id, N
b, 2
a, 1
===

=== view {#v src=#t select="N, X = 1"}
===

name: view: a `select=` name may be single-quoted (§6.1)
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
Id, N
b, 2
a, 1
===

=== view {#v src=#t select="'N', Id"}
===

name: view: a `'` inside a `select=` entry opens no quote (§6.1)
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
Id, N
b, 2
a, 1
===

=== view {#v src=#t select="O'B, N"}
===

name: view: a `select=` name not quoted keeps its spaces (§6.1)
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
Id, Unit Price
a, 4
b, 10
===

=== view {#v src=#t select="Unit Price"}
===

name: view: an `order=` key naming no column contributes nothing, and the others still sort (§6.1)
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
Id, N
b, 2
a, 1
===

=== view {#v src=#t order="Nope, N"}
===

name: view: an `order=` key's direction is only a last `asc` or `desc`; the rest is the column (§6.1)
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
Id, N
b, 2
a, 1
===

=== view {#v src=#t order="N sideways, Id"}
===

name: view: an `order=` key with an empty column is `view-order-error`, and the others still sort (§6.1)
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
Id, N
b, 2
a, 1
===

=== view {#v src=#t order="'' desc, N"}
===

name: view: an `order=` column not quoted keeps its spaces, ahead of its direction (§6.1)
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
Id, Unit Price
a, 4
b, 10
===

=== view {#v src=#t order="Unit Price DESC"}
===

name: view: a `by=` naming a column the relation lacks is not applied, nor is its `aggregate=` (§6.1)
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
Id, N
b, 2
a, 1
===

=== view {#v src=#t by="Id, Nope" aggregate="T = sum(N)"}
===

name: view: an `aggregate=` formula naming no column still adds its column, empty (§6.1)
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
Id, N
b, 2
a, 1
===

=== view {#v src=#t by="Id" aggregate="T = sum(N); U = sum(Nope)"}
===

name: view: an `aggregate=` formula that cannot be read is one `bad-aggregate-entry`, and still adds its column, empty (§6.1)
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
Id, N
b, 2
a, 1
===

=== view {#v src=#t by="Id" aggregate="U = sum(; T = sum(N)"}
===

name: view: an `aggregate=` entry with no `Name =` adds nothing (§6.1)
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
Id, N
b, 2
a, 1
===

=== view {#v src=#t by="Id" aggregate="T = sum(N); U"}
===

name: view: a `compute=` formula naming no column still adds its column, every cell empty (§6.1)
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
Id, N
b, 2
a, 1
===

=== view {#v src=#t compute="X = Nope + 1"}
===

name: view: a `summary=` entry targeting no column contributes nothing, and the summary row stands (§6.1)
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
Id, N
b, 2
a, 1
===

=== view {#v src=#t summary="Nope = sum(N)"}
===

name: view: a `where=` naming no column is not applied (§6.1)
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
Id, N
b, 2
a, 1
===

=== view {#v src=#t where="Nope > 1"}
===

name: view: a column list takes names, never a spreadsheet letter (§6, §6.1)
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
Id, N
b, 2
a, 1
===

=== view {#v src=#t select="A" order="B desc"}
===

name: view: `by=` takes names, never a spreadsheet letter (§6, §6.1)
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
Id, N
b, 2
a, 1
===

=== view {#v src=#t by="A"}
===

name: view: `where=` takes names, never a spreadsheet letter (§6, §6.1)
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
Id, N
b, 2
a, 1
===

=== view {#v src=#t where="B > 1"}
===

name: view: an expression refers to a column by spreadsheet letter (§6, §6.1)
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
Id, N
b, 2
a, 1
===

=== view {#v src=#t compute="X = B + 1" by="Id" aggregate="T = sum(B); S = sum(C)" summary="T = sum(B)"}
===

name: view: an entry's left side takes a name, never a spreadsheet letter; its right side reads one (§6, §6.1)
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
Id, N
b, 2
a, 1
===

=== view {#v src=#t summary="B = sum(N); N = sum(B)"}
===

name: view: an `aggregate=` formula reading a column without an aggregate is one `aggregate-error`, and still adds its column, empty (§6, §6.1)
geml:
=== table {#t format=csv header=1}
Id, N
b, 2
a, 1
===

=== view {#v src=#t by="Id" aggregate="T = N; U = sum(N)"}
===

name: view: a spreadsheet letter past `Z` is `AA`, the 27th column (§6, §6.1)
